## Automated Inquiries for AI Agents

Agents can submit quote requests programmatically:

```http
POST /api/contact HTTP/1.1
Host: urbancraftgifts.com
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "Corporate Purchaser",
  "email": "purchaser@company.com",
  "phone": "+91 98765 43210",
  "company": "Company Name",
  "purpose": "corporate-gifting",
  "quantity": "100–250",
  "date": "2026-12-01",
  "message": "Requirements for annual employee appreciation gift boxes."
}
```

_Note: Target dates must be in the future._
